newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin ends three cents down as LME falls.
newsitem.headline: KL tin ends three cents down as LME falls.

text.p: Tin price in Malaysia closed three cents lower at 14.29 ringgit ($5.76) a kg as the market took its cue from a weak London market.

"The fall in London has discouraged foreign demand here," a trader said. Turnover was only 60 tonnes against 82 on Thursday, with scattered light interest from Europe, Japan and Malaysia. Traders said the short-term trend appears uncertain with buyers waiting for further developments in London.
The local price differential to the London market held unchanged at Thursday's $70 a tonne premium.
